revenue_body.label: Revenue commentary
revenue_body.value: Second quarter revenue of $1,450,138 finished $153,093, or 9.5%, below the budget of $1,603,231. Gross potential rent outperformed at $1,346,580 against $1,130,031, a favourable variance of $216,549 or 19.2%, but gain to lease came in at only $9,961 versus $367,215 budgeted, a shortfall of $357,254. Concessions of $53,131 exceeded the $15,000 budget by $38,131. Vacancy was the one offset, at $100,437 against $109,996 budgeted, favourable by $9,559 or 8.7%.

opex_body.label: Operating expense commentary
opex_body.value: Operating expenses totalled $814,032 for the quarter against a budget of $832,760, a favourable variance of $18,728 or 2.2%. Insurance was the largest favourable line at $58,764 below budget, or 43.4%, followed by management fees at $6,786 favourable. Utilities was the largest unfavourable line, running $25,435 over budget at 12.8%, with general and administrative expense $9,524 over and repairs and maintenance $5,874 over. Property taxes came in exactly on budget at $177,303.
